title: Weight admission ramp and runtime certification harness
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Build an end-to-end harness that admits new open-source model weights into our artifact store, performs conversion to runtime-compatible formats, runs deterministic sanity and perf checks, and publishes a validated runtime performance profile. The scope includes provenance stamping, checksum reconciliation, tokenizer and config validation, quantization acceptance testing, basic quality smoke tests (prompt set), and a profile publisher that creates a candidate profile draft for manual review. The harness should be resilient to partial failures and provide clear, actionable telemetry for triage and rollback decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Weights can be ingested from S3/OSS URLs and are immutably stored with provenance metadata (uploader, source URL, checksums).
Automated conversion produces runtime artifacts (native optimized format + quantized variants) with deterministic hash per conversion and an associated compatibility matrix.

Sanity suite runs within CI: binary size and checksum verification, tokenizer round-trip on canonical inputs, KV cache warmup smoke, and end-to-end inference on <5 short prompts with quality thresholds.
Perf harness measures median p50 and p95 token latency for three sequence lengths and reports throughput for batching sizes 1, 4, 16; output written to profile draft.
Profile drafts are published to the model catalog under a draft tag and include clear failure reasons for any missing metrics.
Failure modes are classified (conversion, runtime mismatch, tokenization, perf regression) and surfaced in the UI and logs for SRE/Onboarding team action.
comments: 2026-02-21 - Ravi: Spike completed on ingest edge cases. Found 3 community checkpoints with missing tokenizer.json; implemented fallback to infer BPE vs. unigram using heuristics.

2026-02-26 - Aisha: Design review meeting notes: prefer deterministic conversion pipeline that emits both float16 and int8 candidates. PM asked to ensure cost estimate per variant is included in profile metadata.
2026-03-02 - Ravi: Prototype conversion job now emits conversion checksums and stores conversion logs to /artifacts/convert/<job_id>. Next: wire perf harness to the conversion output path.
2026-03-06 - QA: Ran smoke on 5 community models. Two models failed tokenizer round-trip due to custom EOS behavior; created ENG-158902 to surface tokenization patch and community guidance.
2026-03-10 - DevOps: Added retry/backoff for S3 transient read failures and a reconciliation loop that re-queues stuck conversions older than 24h.
2026-03-12 - Ravi: Initial perf runs completed for batch sizes 1/4/16. Draft profiles generated for 3 models; one shows a 30% p50 regression vs our baseline and is flagged for manual review.
decisions: Emit both float16 and int8 conversion outputs by default; int8 uses pinned quantization recipe v2. This increases storage but avoids on-the-fly quantization costs for Dedicated customers.
Tokenizer validation will try canonical tokenizer.json -> huggingface config -> heuristic fallback. Heuristic is documented and must be logged when used.
Perf profiles are published as 'draft' and require at least one human approval before being promoted to 'stable' in the model catalog.
